skjoldrFirewallApplyProfile.action: Applies a Skjoldr firewall profile to the active network configuration.
skjoldrFirewallApplyProfile.consequence: Network rules change immediately on application. An incorrect profile can block legitimate traffic or open unintended access.

skjoldrFirewallApplyRulesetFile.action: Applies a ruleset file directly to the Skjoldr firewall.
skjoldrFirewallApplyRulesetFile.consequence: Network rules change immediately. Verify the ruleset file contents before applying — there is no dry-run.

skjoldrFirewallExportBaseline.action: Exports the current Skjoldr firewall state as a named baseline snapshot.
skjoldrFirewallExportBaseline.consequence: Creates a point-in-time record. Lower risk than apply operations, but the snapshot becomes a restore target — accuracy matters.

skjoldrFirewallRestoreBaseline.action: Restores the Skjoldr firewall to a previously exported baseline snapshot.
skjoldrFirewallRestoreBaseline.consequence: All current firewall rules are replaced by the baseline. Rules added since the baseline was taken will be removed.

onboarding.question:
Is Skjoldr firewall management part of this deployment?
   Only say yes if the Skjoldr module is being attached. Enabling the capabilities without the module does nothing useful.

wyerdTraderTradingCycle.action: Evaluates a paper trading cycle using 3-model consensus. BASTION seat holds veto power.
wyerdTraderTradingCycle.consequence: Updates paper portfolio balance and KV ledger. No real funds. HIL gate is bypassed in PoC mode — in a live system this step would require human operator approval before execution.

onboarding.question:
Is Wyerd Trader (paper trading PoC) part of this deployment?
   Only enable if the conductor script and CF Worker are configured.

kennrDesignExtract.action: Extracts design tokens (color palette, typography, spacing, visual style) from a target URL or HTML source via the Kennr CF Worker.
kennrDesignExtract.consequence: Read-only. Makes an outbound request to the target URL and to the Kennr Worker AI layer. No writes to local state.

kennrDesignDnaSynthesize.action: Synthesizes multiple Kennr extractions into a unified Design DNA profile.
kennrDesignDnaSynthesize.consequence: Read-only synthesis pass. Writes the resulting profile to the Kennr Worker D1 database — no local filesystem writes.

kennrDesignDiff.action: Compares two Design DNA profiles and returns a divergence report.

onboarding.question:
Is Kennr Design DNA Extractor part of this deployment?
   Only enable if the Kennr CF Worker (kennr-worker) is deployed and accessible.

skadiLeadScan.action: Triggers an outbound lead scan for one Western Slope CO market via the Skadi CF Worker.
skadiLeadScan.consequence: Makes outbound requests to OSM and Foursquare. Writes results to Airtable. HIL gate is bypassed in PoC mode — in a live system this step would require human operator approval before scan.

onboarding.question:
Is Skadi (Western Slope CO lead gen) part of this deployment?
   Only enable if the Skadi CF Worker is deployed with Airtable and Foursquare secrets configured.

fenerisSecurityStatus.action: Reads current security state from the Feneris watchdog via Unix socket.
fenerisSecurityStatus.consequence: Read-only. Connects to /run/feneris/feneris.sock and returns system state + last ledger event. No writes.

onboarding.question:
Is Feneris Security Layer part of this deployment?
   Requires feneris-watchdog.service running and echostation user in the feneris group.
